column1: # Kirian — Japanese. Kirian owns this file: the store only merges it on top of
# templates/i18n/{cs,ja}.tsv when building this app's pages.
# `label.<source>` rows translate the skin gallery manifests, which are
# generated from the game repo by `make import-skins`. Keying on the source
# string (and not on a row number) is what lets the manifests be regenerated
# without invalidating the translation; anything with no row here — ship and
# enemy names, skin titles — passes through untouched, which is what we want
